$comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/check-v2-normative-home.mjs (RFC 0189). THREE rules: `undeclared` may never rise; `undeclared + v1Dependent` may never rise; `facetsUncovered` may never rise. `v1Dependent` alone is unconstrained UPWARD on purpose — moving a family from undeclared to honestly-v1-dependent gains information and leaves total debt unchanged, and the pre-0189 rule exited 1 on exactly that move, which made silence the cheapest way to stay green. Lower these when you resolve something; never raise.
$openAtT0Comment: Re-seeded 2026-09-19 from 68 to 66 when the burn-down denominator changed from `v1Dependent + undeclared` to what RFC 0189 §D actually makes fatal (`undeclared + uncarried`). 66 is what `undeclared` was at t0; the 2 v1-dependent families of that day are no longer counted by the calendar. A SNAPSHOT taken at the start of t0, not a running total. `undeclared` + `v1Dependent` below are CURRENT and are already lower — two commits on t0 retired five families. The difference is real headroom in the burn-down and is intentional; do not 'reconcile' them by lowering openAtT0, which would retroactively steepen a schedule already met.

v1Banners.spec/v1/capabilities.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.1.** Normative `/.well-known/openwop` discovery and capability-advertisement contract.
v1Banners.spec/v1/host-capabilities.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.1 · RFC 0144 and owning feature RFCs.** Normative pack-facing contracts for advertised `host.*` services.
v1Banners.spec/v1/multi-agent-execution.md: > **Status: Draft · v1.x · RFC 0037, 0039–0041, 0061 `Accepted`; spec status Draft pending the open `version: 2`–`4` follow-ups mae-1–mae-9 in `gaps.json`.** Normative execution, handoff, memory, causation, replay, and agent-loop contract.
v1Banners.spec/v1/ai-envelope.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.1.1 · RFC 0021, 0030–0033.** Normative contract for typed AI outputs, validation, refusal, reasoning, and retry behavior.
v1Banners.spec/v1/budget-policy.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.x · RFC 0084.** Capability-gated budget, quota, and cost-enforcement contract.
v1Banners.spec/v1/node-packs.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.1.** Normative contract for the pack manifest format, distribution, signing, and the registry HTTP API. The hosted reference registry is `https://packs.openwop.dev/`.
v1Banners.spec/v1/agent-evaluation.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.x · RFC 0081.** Capability-gated evaluation suite, scorecard, and deployment-promotion contract.
v1Banners.spec/v1/agent-memory.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.1.** Normative cross-run agent-memory contract: `memoryRef` resolution, the `MemoryAdapter` host interface, cross-tenant isolation (CTI-1), and BYOK secret redaction (SR-1).
v1Banners.spec/v1/agent-org-chart.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.x · RFC 0087.** Capability-gated descriptive org chart; organizational position never grants protocol authority.
v1Banners.spec/v1/agent-runtime.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.x · RFC 0097.** Capability-gated standing goals with bounded, judge-based continuation.
v1Banners.spec/v1/artifact-type-packs.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.1 · RFC 0071, amended by RFC 0075.** Normative contract for portable and host-registered artifact-type definitions.
v1Banners.spec/v1/production-profile.md: > **Status: Stable · v1.1.** Operational-readiness profile for public OpenWOP hosts. Additive: combines existing v1 contracts into a production claim without changing required wire shapes.
v1Banners.spec/v1/prompts.md: > **Status: Draft · v1.x · RFC 0027 `Accepted`; spec status Draft pending the open prompt gaps p1–p8 in `gaps.json` (reference-host resolution, `prompt.composed` emission and `/v1/prompts*` endpoints, and a first non-steward host advertising `capabilities.prompts.supported`).** Normative shape and resolution rules for portable, versioned prompt templates.

$v1CarriedComment: RFC 0189 §D. At v1 end-of-support, spec/v1/** is FROZEN-BUT-OPERATIVE for exactly these families: EOS ends new v1 wire support, it does not de-normativize prose a v2 family still points at. After the date the gate fails only if one of these targets is DELETED or its Status banner changes — which is the real hazard, rather than a calendar square.
